hooks.name: Run skeleton tests on save
hooks.description: When a TypeScript file under skeleton/src/ is saved, run the skeleton test suite. Reports failures to the agent. Edits nothing.

action.command: out=$(pnpm --filter @kiroween/skeleton test 2>&1); code=$?; if [ "$code" -ne 0 ]; then printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -E 'FAIL|AssertionError|Error:|Test Files|Tests ' | head -60 >&2; exit "$code"; fi; printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -E 'Test Files|Tests '
